heldBy.label: Held by
heldBy.counter: {method} at the counter · held by you

balances.title: Fees & balances
balances.description: What Counterfoil charges on this venue's sales, what we will pay you, and what you owe us.
balances.toDateNote: All time — the period below does not change these.
balances.payYouHelp: Sales taken on Counterfoil's account, after the {platform} platform fee and the {gateway} gateway fee, less refunds of that money.
balances.oweUsHelp: The {platform} platform fee on sales you took yourself — on your own account, in cash, or on your counter terminal.
balances.neverNetted: The two are settled separately and never set against each other.
balances.bothSwitch: This venue switched its {provider} payments to {to} on {date}. Sales before that were taken on {fromLabel}, sales after it on {toLabel}.
balances.bothCounter: Online sales on Counterfoil's account build up what we pay you; cash and counter sales are held by you, so the platform fee on them is what you owe us.
balances.movementsHelp: Every payment and refund in the period, with its fees. Open one to see how the figures were worked out.
balances.exported: Exported {count, plural, one {# movement} other {# movements}}
balances.emptyMessage: No payments or refunds at this venue in this period.

breakdown.title: Why this amount?
breakdown.vatNote: VAT is yours to remit, so no fee is charged on it.
breakdown.platform: Platform fee · {rate} of the fee base
breakdown.gateway: Gateway fee · {rate} of the fee base
breakdown.gatewayNoneNote: None — the money did not go through Counterfoil's gateway.
breakdown.platformHeld: Counterfoil received this money. We keep the fees and pay you the rest.
breakdown.operatorHeld: You received this money. You owe us the platform fee on it.
breakdown.refundPlatform: Refunded from money Counterfoil holds, so what we pay you drops by the full amount. Fees are not returned.
breakdown.refundOperator: Refunded from money you hold. Nothing changes between you and Counterfoil — fees are not returned.
breakdown.notYet: Not yet in a payout or collection
breakdown.fixedNote: Fees are fixed when the money moves. A later switch or rate change never rewrites this.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.description: Money Counterfoil has sent, or will send, to your bank for sales taken on Counterfoil's account.
payouts.estimated: Estimated — it grows until the run closes.
payouts.schedule: Paid {schedule}. Each payout carries the Counterfoil-held sales since the last one, less fees and refunds.
payouts.noDestination: Payouts are on hold until you add a bank account.
payouts.pendingDestination: Your new bank details are being verified. Payouts go there once they are.
payouts.emptyMessage: Payouts appear once this venue takes online payments on Counterfoil's account.
payouts.linesHelp: Every payment and refund in this payout. Each one traces to an order.

collections.title: Fee collections
collections.description: The platform fee on sales you took yourself, and what you have paid of it.
collections.terms: Invoiced every week on Sunday for the week before, due within {days} days. Paid online by card or bKash.
collections.payBody: The platform fee on {count, plural, one {# sale} other {# sales}} you took yourself between {from} and {to}.
collections.pastDueBanner: {count, plural, one {A fee collection is} other {# fee collections are}} past due — {amount} to pay.
collections.emptyMessage: Collections appear once this venue takes payments it holds itself.
collections.linesHelp: Every sale this collection charges the platform fee on.

settings.accountsDesc: Which account online payments go into — Counterfoil's, or your own. Each venue can choose, and switch at any time.
settings.counterfoilDisclosure: We collect the payment. {platform} platform fee + {gateway} gateway fee per transaction. We pay you the rest {cadence}.
settings.ownDisclosure: Payments go straight to you. {platform} platform fee per transaction. We collect it from you every week.
settings.defaultsDesc: Every venue uses these unless it has its own.
settings.perVenueDesc: A venue can follow the default or have accounts of its own.
settings.keysBody: Payments will go into your own {provider} merchant account. Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again.
settings.keysRemoved: {provider} keys removed — back on Counterfoil's account
settings.switchBody: Payments taken from now on will use {to}. Payments already taken keep their existing fees and settlement.
settings.followDefaultBody: {venue} will use the default accounts from now on, and its own keys will be removed. Payments already taken keep their fees and settlement.
settings.bankDesc: Where Counterfoil sends what we owe you.
settings.bankNone: No bank details yet — payouts are on hold until you add them.
settings.bankSaved: Bank details saved — we'll verify them before the next payout
settings.adminOnly: Only admins can change payment accounts and bank details.
settings.removeKeysBody: The keys are deleted. If this account is taking payments on your own account, it moves back to Counterfoil's first, so no sale is refused.
